job.rawJd:
Company-targeted networking brief based on BioLumina's public website, not an employer job description.

Audience: BioLumina leaders across healthcare strategy, customer experience, experience design, digital transformation, creative, and technology.

Company context: BioLumina is a full-service healthcare creative agency serving biotech and pharmaceutical organizations. Its published capabilities include strategic consulting and brand development, scientific and medical strategy, omnichannel customer experience, digital data integration, experience design and transformation, global and local execution, and relationship marketing.

The company's public positioning centers on curiosity, the biology of disease, human behavior, customer insight, and connecting science, strategy, and creativity for HCP and consumer audiences.

This package is for company-specific networking. It must be fit-gated again against any specific BioLumina job description.

resume.summary: Healthcare experience strategy and UX leader with more than eight years in UX and product design, backed by a 15-year career across pharma, healthcare, enterprise platforms, and client strategy. I use research and user needs to shape journeys, prototypes, reusable systems, and build-ready direction. At Kinesso, I grew product design from 2 to 30 and led design for enterprise analytics used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands. My pharma work includes patient, HCP, and internal experiences within FDA, HIPAA, and MLR requirements.
